notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to version 1.3.0.

[list]
[*] Faster player movement speed has been set.
[*] Small lighting enhancement has been made.
[/list]
Cheers!

notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hey walkers,
Right after Drizzlepath: Deja Vu, Nephise: Ascension, Bottle: Pilgrim, and Drizzlepath: Glass, now The Hunting God too has full controller support!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29707373/95ecc06ee653304088b48c9db240887c9a86e413.jpg[/img]
Again, if you need localized menus for the game, you'll have to go to game properties, select Betas tab, and from the dropdown menu select "localui" branch. If you don't do that, the game will still have the option for localized subtiitles, but the localui brach is only for the additional localizations for the menus.

Other than that I added lots of foliage to the Earth level. Now it looks much better than before.

If you encounter any bugs, please post it on the discussions page.

Have a great week wherever you are, and don't forget to pet the baby deer! :btlgazelle:

notes.title: Steam Developer Page Live!
notes.notes:
Hello walkers!
Steam now has a new feature, and it is the developer pages!
I have set up my own developer page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/tongucbodur/

Check it out and make sure you  hit the Follow button at the top, so you won't miss my announcements in the future such as upcoming projects and stuff. If you want to follow me on social media, the links to my Twitter and Youtube pages are also on the developer page.

Also from that page you can view which one of my games are on sale,
so you grab'em at lower costs.

If you want to support me further, why don't you also share the page on your Activity Feed
so your friends hear my games, too!

Thanks everyone, and game on! :btlthumbup:

Tonguç
